What is Brubru

Brubru is an AI-powered strategic advocacy assistant for EU policy professionals. It combines conversational AI with legislative tools to help users analyse policies, draft amendments, and navigate EU institutional processes.

Built by Beresol, a Brussels-based public affairs technology company, Brubru serves lobbyists, trade associations, law firms, and NGOs working in the EU bubble.

The EU produces 50,000+ legislative acts. Brubru helps you find what matters.

AI Policy Chat —Ask questions about any EU law, procedure, or institution
Amendment Drafting —AI-assisted legislative amendments in Akoma Ntoso XML
RSS Feed Aggregation —Monitor 15+ EU institutional sources in one place
Legislative Predictions —AI-powered outcome forecasts for EP and Council votes
EU Law Comply —Compliance gap analysis against EU legislation
Document Generation —Position papers, MEP briefings, talking points
Legislative Train Tracker —Follow 500+ legislative files through the EU process
EP Committee Monitoring —Track work in progress across all 26 EP committees
Public Consultations —Discover and participate in EC "Have Your Say" consultations
6 Languages —Full interface localisation in English, French, Dutch, Spanish, Catalan and Italian

Brubru replaces expensive consultants and fragmented tools with a single AI-powered platform that covers the full EU advocacy workflow - from research to amendment drafting to compliance checking.

How Brubru Works

From research question to policy action in minutes, not weeks

Brubru’s AI understands EU institutional processes, legislative procedures, and policy context. Here’s how professionals use it every day.

01

Ask a policy question

Type any EU policy question in natural language. Brubru’s AI draws on a knowledge base of 50,000+ EU laws, EP committee reports, Commission proposals, EPRS briefings, and 11 Beresol open reports covering topics from AI Act implementation to CBAM compliance.

02

Track what matters

Set up RSS feeds from the European Parliament, Council, Commission, EUR-Lex, and more. Track specific legislative files through the Legislative Train, monitor EP committee work, and get alerts on public consultations with upcoming deadlines.

03

Draft amendments

Load any EU regulation or directive from EUR-Lex, select the article or recital you want to amend, and let the AI suggest changes. Export in Akoma Ntoso XML, PDF, or Word format following official EP formatting guidelines.

04

Generate documents

Produce AI-powered position papers, MEP briefing notes, and talking points tailored to your policy area. Run compliance gap analysis with EU Law Comply to check how new legislation affects your organisation or sector.

For developers and RegTech partners

The EU, structured. REST API and MCP server.

Brubru is a vertical EU data provider. The same 28,505 laws, 1,296 procedures, live consultation feedback, commissioner agendas, and legal-text intelligence that power the Brubru app are exposed as a paid REST API and as an MCP server. Brubru itself is the first user of its own API. Built for RegTech, law firms, public-affairs teams, and AI agents.

Explore the API API reference

REST API endpoints (Professional subscription, 60 req/min):

GET /api/v2/proprietary/brussels-lobbies

Every Brussels-based EUTR org, ranked, with their own news

GET /api/v2/legislative/eur-lex/laws

28,505 adopted EU laws, full-text + filters

GET /api/v2/legislative/oeil/procedures

1,200+ legislative files in flight

GET /api/v2/commission/commissioners/{name}/agenda

Live calendar for all 27 college members

GET /api/v2/commission/consultations/.../feedback

Live Have Your Say stakeholder input

GET /api/v2/legislative/eur-lex/laws/{celex}/recital-article-map

TF-IDF recital-article linker

MCP server tools (compatible with Claude, GPT, Cursor, Windsurf):

ask_brubru

Ask any EU policy question

search_eu_legislation

Search 28,505 EU laws

search_knowledge_guides

128 curated policy guides

get_procedure_status

Legislative procedure tracker

get_calendar_events

EU institutional calendar

search_eprs

EP Research publications

Same canonical pagination envelope across every endpoint. OpenAPI 3.1 spec at /api/v2/openapi.json — importable into Postman in one click.
Interested in integrating? Contact hello@beresol.eu

About Brubru

Built in Brussels, for the EU bubble

Brubru is developed by Beresol, a Brussels-based public affairs technology company. We combine deep understanding of EU institutional processes with cutting-edge AI to create tools that actually work for policy professionals.

Our mission is to democratise access to EU policy intelligence. Whether you’re a lobbyist tracking legislative files, an NGO drafting amendments, or a trade association monitoring consultations - Brubru gives you the same analytical power as the largest firms in town.

GDPR Compliant

EU-hosted infrastructure. Your data stays in Europe.

Multilingual

AI understands and responds in all EU languages.

Multi-AI Engine

Mistral, Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini for reliability.

50,000+ EU Laws

Comprehensive knowledge base of EU legislation.

Victor Solé Ferioli

Founder & CEO, Beresol

Brussels-based public affairs professional and technologist. Victor founded Beresol to bridge the gap between EU policy expertise and modern AI technology, making institutional knowledge accessible to everyone in the EU bubble.
